2.source: relic set 314 (出云显世与高天神国 / Izumo Gensei and Takama Divine Realm), 2-piece: 「使装备者的攻击力提高#1[i]%。进入战斗时，若至少存在一名与装备者命途相同的队友，装备者的暴击率提高#2[i]%。」 param = [0.12, 0.12]
2.note: The conditional half only: 「使装备者的攻击力提高 12%」 is a plain stat and is already carried by the ability's `properties` (AttackAddedRatio 0.12), which the suit applies when it is built -- writing it here as well would grant it twice. ⚠ 「若至少存在一名与装备者**命途相同**的队友」 is `self has_same_path_ally`: the rule cannot name a Path, because the relic can be worn by anybody, so it compares the wearer's own Path against the rest of the side. ⚠ `permanent: true` is 「进入战斗时」 with no duration stated -- a battle-start grant that nothing counts down.
